_about: Public-domain Gertrude the Great (1256-1302, nun of Helfta) in English for the Word Hoard: The Life and Revelations of Saint Gertrude (London: Burns & Oates, from the Kenmare translation of 1865), which renders Books 2-5 of her Herald of Divine Love, and The Exercises of Saint Gertrude (London: Burns and Lambert, translator's note 1863), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 25 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

gertrude-life-and-revelations: The Life and Revelations of Saint Gertrude, Virgin and Abbess, new edition (London: Burns & Oates, Limited; letter dated 1870)
gertrude-exercises: The Exercises of Saint Gertrude, translated from Dom Guéranger's edition (London: Burns and Lambert; translator's note dated 1863)

_alternates.gertrude-exercises-pope: The Exercises of St. Gertrude, tr. Thomas Alder Pope (Burns Oates and Washbourne, imprimatur 1921)
_alternates.gertrude-preces: Preces Gertrudianae: prayers compiled from Gertrude and Mechtilde (Burns and Lambert, undated)

_excluded.gertrude-about: The Spirit of St. Gertrude (a compilation) and works about her (1888, 1911, 1913)
